- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4277-4342 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `&& env.INTEGRATION_TEST_REPAIR_ACTIVE != 'true'` skip clause was appended to the two merge steps ("Enable auto-merge on PR" and "Mark linked issues ready to merge", cited as 4309/4339 or 4312/4342) but not to the "Single-issue security pass" gate at line 4277; it also sits after the `steps.single_issue_security_pass.outputs.hold != 'true'` clause, which breaks the parity and endswith-hold invariants.
  WHY: CI on head 6665beb9 fails `tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py::test_review_wiring` (assertions at lines 934-936), so tests-hooks-and-orchestrator fails and the aggregate lint job blocks merge; a `post_sync_test_repair` run can also still post or refresh pending-audit markers, dispatch an audit, or use up security cycles even though it reviewed nothing. All reviewers rated this BLOCKER (google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite filed it under SECURITY & INPUT VALIDATION). Proposed fix: append the clause to line 4277, move it in front of the hold clause on the merge steps, and change `raw.count(...) == 19` to 20 in tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py::test_post_sync_test_repair_skips_every_reviewer_and_editor_step.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4421 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The if: of "Review-blocked judge decision" (id rb_judge) has no `env.INTEGRATION_TEST_REPAIR_ACTIVE != 'true'` clause, so the judge runs when a repair dispatch reaches `max_iterations_reached == 'true'`; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash adds that the dependent steps at 4507, 4618, 4660, 4685 and 5341 inherit the same gap.
  WHY: The judge decides fix-up, approve or block from stale or missing review artifacts in a run that skipped the reviewers and editor, which is a merge-authorization leak. openai_gpt-6-luna adds that the judge's fix path (`scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` lines 2657–2673) commits and directly pushes a `[judge-fix]` change. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it BLOCKER; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it MAJOR; the highest is used.
- tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py:test_review_wiring | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `test_review_wiring` fails because the `if` of the `single_issue_security_pass` gate no longer matches the auto-merge `if` expectation.
  WHY: The `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` CI job fails, so the PR cannot reach a mergeable state.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:_resolver_test_repair_context (mktemp) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `comments_raw="$(mktemp "${RUNTIME_DIR}/test_repair_comments.XXXXXX")" || return 1` returns rc 1, which `_resolver_test_repair_main` maps to the misleading `reason=identity_unavailable`.
  WHY: The run stays fail-closed, but the log sends the operator to the identity call instead of RUNTIME_DIR. All three reviewers rated it NIT. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputes it: the path is unreachable because RUNTIME_DIR must already exist when the mktemp call runs.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
